:::: {.concept-card key="dynamics" tags="physics robotics"}
## environment dynamics

The rule or probability law by which a system’s state evolves, potentially depending on the current state and action.
It describes the environment’s evolution rather than the policy’s action selection.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="feedback" tags="physics robotics"}
## feedback

Information measured from a system and used to update subsequent decisions about that system.
In control, the relevant feedback level may be task planning or a lower-level motor loop.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="homogeneous-response" tags="mathematics physics"}
## homogeneous response

The part of a dynamical system response generated by its initial state when the external input is zero.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="state-vector" tags="mathematics physics robotics"}
## state vector

Coordinates representing the information a dynamical model uses to specify subsequent evolution, or its probability law, given future inputs.
The entries may describe physical quantities or an internal model representation.
::::
